intent:
"yes approbe and begin the implementation" started the bstack build slice by slice, strictly one at a time ("keep it sequential"). Later: "i'm only not concerned about security hardening, threat-model concerns. Style and simplification and following proper design principles are still important." - build the full app fast, but review the core properly so slices and phases do not leave bugs.

The plans of record are in the repo: `docs/design.md` (requirements and decisions, including R24: licensing is out of scope) and `docs/implementation-plan.md` (tasks, task evidence contract). knowttl/bstack is public, has no GitHub Actions or workflows and no release automation, and ships through the no-mistakes pipeline with automatic merge of green work. Landed: Phase 0, Phase 1, T2.1-T2.5 and T2.6 part 1 (https://github.com/knowttl/bstack/pull/25: change-set and resume schemas, plan digest, staged operations with a conservative supported Markdown subset, and `apply --dry-run`).

This piece is slice C14b, the rest of task T2.6 "Build protected writes and resume state": write/journal/resume, including selected delete. Done evidence: injected interruption points, backups, original/proposed/conflict states, repeat and dirty-user protection.

cases.procedure: unrelated uncommitted journey and selected file permissions survive writes
apply rejects unresolved scope with no project writes; apply rejects changed scope resolution with no project writes; apply rejects unedited concrete scope failures with no project writes
protected append saves originals and repeat performs no writes; a user change to a completed run blocks repetition

apply rejects invalid schema with no project writes; apply rejects target mismatch with no project writes; escaping links fail with an unchanged project fingerprint and outside bytes; changed later precondition prevents all edits and reports every changed file

replace/delete/create interruption before-write, after-replacement, before-completion and journal-io resumes from actual hashes and keeps backups; user change to other.txt after replace interruption blocks every remaining write

limitations: Linux Node 24 execution only. Real Windows/macOS runs remain captain checklist evidence; no hosted CI ran.

205 T2.6 tests and 635 full-suite tests passed. Case mappings record local command controls, not fresh-agent transcript acceptance for AC-54, AC-57 or AC-69. Full path acceptance remains the later integration checkpoints.

Affected checks are reported from reviewed findings required outcomes. Automatic execution remains T2.7. Atomicity covers individual files only; unsupported directory flushes report power-loss limitations.
